name: smh_pvm_ref_s2-s2-COMMIT
purpose: SAFE2: isolated p192 calibrated SRAM macro5.15pins/um, full N face tilepins, one north logic band216..302.4, outline302.4square. Original SRAM/SAFE1 RTL unchanged; merge/fold calendars identical to SAFE1.

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_hbm_sm_pv_merge_s2 #(.TAGW(16), .LV(4), .PUBLISH(1), .TURNREG(1), .SAFE(1)) u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_prefix.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fastfp.sv rtl/proto/ot_fp32_add_rne_pipe.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fp32_add_lat.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fp32_mul_lat.sv rtl/gpu/ot_gpu_fadd.sv physical/asap7_memory_macros/ot_sram_1r1w_64x512_m1_r2c2_p192/ot_sram_1r1w_64x512_m1_r2c2_p192_bb.v rtl/hbm_accel/sm/attn/ot_hbm_sm_pv_merge_s2.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/smh_pvm_ref_s2/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/smh_pvm_ref_s2/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/smh_pvm_ref_s2 --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_hbm_sm_pv_merge_s2 --macro-view physical/asap7_memory_macros/ot_sram_1r1w_64x512_m1_r2c2_p192 > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run
